method.walk: allocate budget to ascending ask levels, quote_i=min(quote_left,price_i*base_qty_i), total_base=sum(quote_i/price_i), VWAP=sum(quote_i)/total_base
method.filled_condition: all quote budget covered by five historical ask levels; not an executed fill
method.statistic: Median of fillable snapshots only, with independent filter per instrument; paired win counts require both instruments fillable. p95 uses linear interpolation.

warnings: Historic, sparse and non-continuous top-five-level books; queue priority and true fills not proven.
No instrument state/minSz/lotSz/tickSz, EEE account permissions or current fees rechecked.
Fee of 0.10% buy-only is hypothetical; any real trading fee may differ.
USD, USDT and USDC are not treated as equivalent; all depth is in USDC.
At non-coverable sizes, residual quote is logged and no full-order VWAP or impact estimate is asserted.
Not a PAPER certification or investment recommendation.
